title: Sky Knowledge Database
purpose: Mind-map knowledge database for astronomy and space study, with test-bank questions linked to their learning topics without duplicating question content.
important_limitations: This database tracks knowledge structure and topic coverage only; it does not duplicate question content.
Question-bank records are linked by question ID and taxonomy node; question text remains in the source batch files.
Use the knowledge map to organize learning pathways and continue adding linked quiz batches as the taxonomy grows.
